def select_next_node(current_node, destination_node, unvisited_nodes, distance_matrix):
    remaining_nodes = len(unvisited_nodes)
    weight = 0.3 + 0.7 * (remaining_nodes / len(distance_matrix))
    next_node = min(unvisited_nodes, key=lambda node: distance_matrix[current_node][node] * weight + (1 / (1 + (1 - weight) * distance_matrix[node][destination_node])))
    return next_node
